opening.argument: The presentation lays out a direct path into BitConnect lending: deposit Bitcoin, buy BitConnect Coin, then lend BCC or invest in USD to “Earn Daily Profit.” Its lending table advertises daily interest and volatility-software interest “up to 40% per month,” while the title links a minimum $100 lending amount to everyday payments and about 30% monthly. The offering is framed as a “SAFE AND SECURE BITCOIN INVESTMENT SOLUTION,” followed by a “REGISTER NOW!” prompt. Taken together, these are not incidental mentions of cryptocurrency; they promote a lending investment with substantial claimed returns, provide steps to participate, and urge registration. The incomplete transfer instruction does not erase the presentation’s clear deposit, lending, and profit claims.
